The `src` folder of https://github.com/ianmackenzie/elm-step-file at commit dba60d5b6c479186072389e3d4eb1514d911ac52 (version 8.0.1,
published as `ianmackenzie/elm-iso-10303`), without `Step/Examples.elm`. It's used by
`src/StepImport.elm` to read STEP files. It can be swapped for the package once it's certain which
name the package resolves under; the modules are the same.
